inputs.style: Indian man in his mid forties speaking English with a warm Indian accent. Calm and even, unhurried; reads the number, then the receipt it came from, and never sounds surprised.
inputs.text: I'm Tally, your accountant, and I keep the books you keep meaning to get to. I match every payment to a receipt and every receipt to a payment, and I tell you about the line that doesn't add up before you have to ask.
